parsed.note_claim: Reports identify the co-pilot as Hamam al-Hammami.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The co-pilot accused of attacking the captain of a FlyDubai flight bound for Israel on Wednesday has been identified as 29-year-old Omani national Hamam al-Hammami, according to U.S. media reports.
